headword: {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}

definitions.gloss: group action; collective behavior; acting as a group
definitions.explanation: Behavior or actions performed together as a group rather than individually. An important concept in Japanese schools and workplaces, where coordinated group activity is emphasized.

examples.japanese: {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}が{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm not good at group activities.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}では{集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}の{大切|たいせつ}さを{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: At school, you learn the importance of group behavior.

examples.japanese: {災害時|さいがいじ}には{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて{集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}を{取|と}ることが{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: During a disaster, people are expected to remain calm and act as a group.

notes: Compound of {集団|しゅうだん} (group/collective) + {行動|こうどう} (action/behavior). Common collocations: {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}を{取|と}る (to act collectively), {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}が{苦手|にがて} (to be bad at group activities). In Japanese education, {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう} is actively taught and practiced, including synchronized marching and group exercises during sports festivals. Contrasts with {個人行動|こじんこうどう} (individual action) and {単独行動|たんどくこうどう} (acting alone).
